input: Write a complaint letter to my landlord

gold.taskTitle: Write a complaint letter to your landlord
gold.taskDescription: Draft a formal complaint letter addressed to the user's landlord about a specific issue with their rental property or tenancy.

questions.title: What is the main issue you are complaining about?
questions.description: Identify the specific problem, such as repairs, noise, pests, deposit, rent, or neighbour disputes.

questions.title: How long has this issue been going on?
questions.description: Understand the duration of the problem to establish urgency and history.

questions.title: Have you already reported this to your landlord verbally or in writing?
questions.description: Determine whether this is a first formal notice or a follow-up after prior communication.

questions.title: What outcome or action do you want from the landlord?
questions.description: Clarify the specific resolution the user is requesting, such as a repair, refund, or apology.

questions.title: Is there a deadline by which you need this resolved?
questions.description: Establish whether the user wants to set a response or action deadline in the letter.

questions.title: What tone do you want the letter to strike?
questions.description: Determine whether the letter should be firm and formal, polite and cooperative, or something in between.

questions.title: Do you have a property address and landlord name to include?
questions.description: Collect the specific names and addresses needed to personalise and formalise the letter.
